notes: v498 — the evidence tiers stop claiming more than the data supports. A full replay of the stored year over both markets (1,977,254 share-days) found two faults in how the app MARKS its scans, not in what they pick. The 'market' each scan was compared against was the average ASX share — dragged to over 200% a year by 540 sub-cent listings, one of which shows a five-day move of +153,400%. Nothing could clear it, which is why so many scans read as losing. And a scan that fires 733 times a day was credited with 733 pieces of evidence a day; they all ride the same market, so it is really one. That overstated confidence by up to eleven times. Tiers now come from evidence measured against the tradeable market, bought a day after the signal, counted by days. There is a new tier — NOT PROVEN — for 'we looked properly and found nothing', which on one year of data is the honest answer for almost every scan. Needs worker w403. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
